授業概要
生物多様性を踏まえた人類存立問題の解明と対処方法について教員が話題を提供し、議論する。
This class is designed to acquire extensive knowledge and sophisticated skills to conduct various analyses and surveys in biodiversity sciences, environmental geography, environmental politics, and resource management sciences.
